## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The AGENTS.md Commands section still tells contributors to run `make test`, which this rename removes, so that stale command needs updating. This repository has no CI, so a contributor who hits the failing command gets no other test run before pushing.

## Changes
The pull request renames the Makefile's `test` target to `check` and updates the README command to match. It also adds a Layout section to AGENTS.md that lists each repository file and the Makefile targets.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- Makefile:6 — comments — Update the AGENTS.md command to `make check` — The rename of `test:` to `check:` makes AGENTS.md:24 false: it still says "Run `make test` before you push; it runs the pytest suite." Running `make test` now fails because the target no longer exists. That line also contradicts the new AGENTS.md:15, "`Makefile` defines the `check` and `lint` targets." — Contributors following the guide's pre-push step get a make error instead of a test run, and this repository has no CI to catch skipped tests. — Fix: Change `make test` to `make check` at `AGENTS.md:24`.
